title: LEGAL ASSOCIATE
description:
Position: LEGAL ASSOCIATE JR  
Experience Required: 0–3 Years  
Location: Noida (Accomodation will be provided)  
Employment Type: Full\-Time

**Overview**

We are seeking a dynamic, resilient, and highly skilled Legal Assistant with exceptional legal drafting competence. The ideal candidate must be confident, articulate, and capable of handling complex legal matters with precision.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Prepare case strategies, draft pleadings, affidavits, briefs, and other legal documents.
* Coordinate with external counsel and monitor case progress effectively

Legal Drafting \& Documentation:

* Draft, vet, and finalize contracts, agreements, notices, deeds, and all forms of legal correspondence.
* Ensure accuracy, clarity, and compliance with legal standards.

Research \& Interpretation:

* Conduct in\-depth legal research on statutes, precedents, and jurisprudential principles.
* Provide practical, well\-reasoned legal interpretations and advice.

Client Handling:

* Manage clients and internal stakeholders effectively, even in sensitive or adverse situations.
* Maintain strong professional relationships and uphold confidentiality.

Problem Solving \& Decision Making:

* Demonstrate keen attention to detail and strong analytical skills.
* Resolve issues efficiently under pressure while maintaining high accuracy

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* We prefer Malayalis who are willing to relocate to Noida
* Bachelor’s degree in Law (LL.B.) from a recognized university; higher qualifications are an added advantage.
* 0–3 years of grounded, practical litigation experience (civil and criminal).
* Excellent drafting, communication, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to work under pressure, meet deadlines, and handle multiple tasks professionally.
* High level of academic competence, integrity, and discipline.
* Strong problem\-solving abilities and meticulous attention to detail.

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* CURRENT SALARY
* EXPECTED SALARY
* NOTICE PERIOD
* Are you comfortable to relocate to Noida,UP (Accomodation will be provided) ?

Work Location: In person
